description: This file sets up an Electron application that creates a BrowserWindow when the app is ready, loads a blank page, and prevents default behavior on window close events.

methods.name: app.whenReady
methods.description: A promise that resolves when Electron app has finished initialization.

methods.name: app.on
methods.description: Registers an event listener for Electron application events.

methods.name: win.loadURL
methods.description: Loads the specified URL into the BrowserWindow.
